description: Validate a payout list before paying many wallets: parses 'address,amount' rows (CSV/TSV/space), checks EVM address format and EIP-55 checksums, flags zero/invalid amounts, duplicate and zero addresses, merges duplicates on request, and returns totals, a clean CSV ready to paste into the batch-payout card, and the fee estimate. Pure computation; nothing is stored or sent.

decimals.description: Max decimals allowed for the token (default 6, e.g. USDC)

mergeDuplicates.description: Sum amounts for repeated addresses (default false: duplicates are reported as issues)

rows.description: One recipient per line: address,amount (header line optional)

name: check_payout_list

csv.description: address,amount lines ready for the batch-payout card
